title: Natural associativity and regular right unit for common-stage tensor
statement: Fix a prime l, a scheme X on which l is invertible, and an algebraic closure Omega of Q_l. Let C be the general algebraically closed constructible coefficient category and T its prescribed common-stage derived tensor bifunctor [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom]. For L in C set right(L) to the functor K ↦ T(K,L). For every L,M in C there is a natural isomorphism right(L) followed by right(M) ≅ right(T(L,M)). Moreover right of the prescribed degree-zero coefficient twist sfQbarTwistingCoefficient(l,X,Omega,0) [def-coefficient-twists-detailed] is naturally isomorphic to the identity functor. These are natural isomorphisms of the actual functors, not only objectwise equivalences, and the unit is the specified untwisted regular coefficient object.

Proof (3), final sentence at algebraically closed coefficients; the common-stage construction of the tensor and its regular coefficient unit

proof.text: For each L,M assemble the prescribed common-stage associators into a natural isomorphism with NatIso.ofComponents. The three-arrow associator naturality equation specialized to f,id_L,id_M is exactly the required functor naturality equation.

The degree-zero integral twist is definitionally the regular completed coefficient. Its reduction is isomorphic to the coherent unit by regularCoefficient_coherentReduction, and the reconstructed integral unit has that same reduction by its counit. Full faithfulness of coherent reduction lifts their composite isomorphism. Apply rational localization and then the inclusion at the least finite coefficient field to identify the specified zero common-stage twist with the reconstructed common-stage unit.

Tensoring the preceding unit isomorphism in the second input gives a natural isomorphism between the two right-tensor functors; bifunctoriality proves its naturality. Assemble the prescribed common-stage right unitors by their naturality equation, then compose to obtain the required natural isomorphism with the identity.

proof_origin.place: Proof (3), final sentence: inverse tensor functors at the algebraically closed coefficient stage. Assembly of canonical naturality squares and the regular-unit identification.

lean.statement:
theorem commonStageTensorLineCoherence
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (X : Scheme.{u})
    [∀ x : X, Invertible (l : X.residueField x)]
    (Ω : Type v) [Field Ω] [Algebra (Padic l) Ω] [IsAlgClosure (Padic l) Ω] :
    let C := generalAlgebraicallyClosedConstructibleCategory l Ω X
    let T := commonStageDerivedTensor l Ω X
    let right (L : C) := (𝟭 C).prod' ((Functor.const C).obj L) ⋙ T
    (∀ (L M : C), Nonempty (right L ⋙ right M ≅ right (T.obj (L, M)))) ∧
      Nonempty (right (sfQbarTwistingCoefficient l X Ω 0) ≅ 𝟭 C)
